android.desc:
Use the MikroTik Home app to apply the most basic initial settings for your MikroTik home access point and manage your home devices. 

Default username on new routers: admin. There is usually no default password (leave empty).

Requirements: a MikroTik router running RouterOS v6 or newer.

• WiFi settings
• Internet settings
• Save and monitor home devices, their usage etc.
• Manage your kids internet access
• Set up Port forwarding
